name: HbA1c
notes: Shows average blood sugar over about 3 months

name: Fasting blood sugar
fasting: Fast for 8 to 10 hours. Plain water is allowed
notes: Take the test in the morning before breakfast

name: Post-meal blood sugar
fasting: Give the sample 2 hours after a normal meal
notes: Note the time you finished eating and tell the lab

name: Pre-surgery blood tests (eye surgery)
also_known_as: pre-op tests;surgery blood tests;pre-operative panel;cataract blood tests
fasting: Fast for 8 to 10 hours. Plain water is allowed
notes: Fasting blood sugar, post-meal blood sugar, complete blood count and urine routine. Bring the doctor's request slip

name: Urine routine
notes: An early morning sample is best. The lab gives you a container
